items.title: Bat Beside a Hanging Fig
items.alt: A brown bat hangs from a short leafy twig beside one ripe purple fig, one wing partly open and muzzle near the fruit.
items.description: A brown bat hangs from a short leafy twig beside one ripe purple fig, one wing partly open and muzzle near the fruit. Useful for nature story prompts.

items.title: Bat Sleeping in Folded Wings
items.alt: A compact smoky-gray bat hangs upside down from a curved bare branch, wings wrapped snugly, eyes closed and two tiny feet gripping above.
items.description: A compact smoky-gray bat hangs upside down from a curved bare branch, wings wrapped snugly, eyes closed and two tiny feet gripping above. Useful for bedtime cards.

items.title: Bat Stretching One Wing
items.alt: A drowsy brown bat hangs by both hind feet and stretches one broad wing outward while the other remains folded around the body.
items.description: A drowsy brown bat hangs by both hind feet and stretches one broad wing outward while the other remains folded around the body. Useful for movement contrast cards.
